title: (RHBA-2018:0291) Update to Fuse Integration Services 2.0 Images
portal_summary: Update to Fuse Integration Services 2.0 images to address OSOP memory limitations.
portal_synopsis: Update to Fuse Integration Services 2.0 Images
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.6|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.5|x86_64
portal_solution:
This update consists of the following parts:
* Updated FIS 2.0 images (provided through the Red Hat container catalog)
* Updated Maven dependencies (provided through the Red Hat Maven repository)

Note the following version changes:
* JBoss Fuse version: JBoss Fuse 6.3.0 Roll Up 5 (build 630310)
* BOM version: 2.2.170.redhat-000022
* Fabric8 Maven plug-in version: 3.1.80.redhat-000022
* Archetype version: 2.2.195.redhat-000016
* Archetype Catalog URL: https://maven.repository.redhat.com/ga/io/fabric8/archetypes/archetypes-catalog/2.2.195.redhat-000016/archetypes-catalog-2.2.195.redhat-000016-archetype-catalog.xml

Update your FIS deployments to use the updated FIS image and update the BOM version and Fabric8 Maven plug-in version in your Maven project file (pom.xml).

For details on how to apply this update, see the patching instructions in "Fuse Integration Services 2.0 for OpenShift" https://access.redhat.com/documentation/en-us/red_hat_jboss_fuse/6.3/html/fuse_integration_services_2.0_for_openshift/patching
portal_description: This update for the Fuse Integration Services 2.0 images adapts the memory limit to work in the context of an OpenShift Online Pro (OSOP) container.
